title: Restyle Heating Video with Physical Fundamentals Glyphs
description: Replace the object drawings and animated effects of the Heating video (house, person, lamp, radiator, sun, sun radiation, heat/energy flow, rooms, windows, thermometer, clock) with the Physical Fundamentals vocabulary from tutorial/manim_visuals.py, keeping the Heating pastel palette. Content (narration, formulas, numbers) stays unchanged. Every scene verified: no overlaps (layout guard + screenshot sheets), animations synced with their subtitle clause. Deliver the full video at 1080p60.
summary: All six Heating parts (Modul 1-5 plus the final calculation) now draw with the Physical Fundamentals glyphs: house_section/room_section, person_glyph/seated_person_glyph, lamp_glyph, radiator, sun_glyph/moon_glyph, straight parallel sun_rays with shine/pulse_flashes, ripples for long-wave heat, flow_animation particles for air/energy flow, thermometer_glyph, clock_glyph, energy_tank. hold_for(during=...) keeps heat, light and air moving while each subtitle is read. Done by six parallel agents (one per part), each independently verified with LAYOUT_CHECK=1 silent plus contact sheets, then re-reviewed by the lead across every beat/scene (two overlap fixes found and corrected during lead review: a particle-flow-through-label issue in Modul 2 Beat3, and a pre-existing readout-column overlap in AnlagenVerluste). full_heating_video.py given the same staleness fix as Cooling. Full video rendered at 1080p60 (35:12) to tutorial/energy/demand/Heating/rendered/Full_Heating_Demand_1080p60.mp4 and spot-checked across its full length.
